intent: Dogfood of the worktree dependency links (#1262). Work ONLY inside your own worktree and make NO file changes, no commits. Do exactly this and keep replies short: (1) report what `node_modules` is in your worktree root — directory or symlink — and whether it contains a `.pnpm` or `.modules.yaml` entry (`ls -la node_modules | head`). (2) In `packages/framework` run `pnpm build` and report the last line. (3) Run `node --import tsx --test src/store/worktree-deps.test.ts` from `packages/framework` and report pass/fail counts. Then you are done — do not call setReadyForMerge.
